doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

title: The Golden Rule band and the Pacific band's uniforms
summary: Tom recalls the short-lived Golden Rule band downtown. Martin counters that the Pacific band had uniforms before it, with scoop hats and plumes, probably blue.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: You don't remember the Golden Rule band? You remember that? Golden Rule, band downtown. But that didn't stay up long. No, it didn't last long. So, Creole and a sudden used to have that band. Manuel used to play in there too.

Pico. That's right. That's what Slowdrag wanted to tell me. That was the first band. Had an uniform. But I know better. The first band had an uniform before the Golden Rule. You take the Pacific had an uniform. Oh, the Pacific. Yeah, that's the Grass Band. That's right. Yeah, the Grass Band. You take... I had a picture of the Pacific there with them. Remember them hats? Yeah, with them. Called them like a scoop.
Yeah, they... What color were their uniforms in the Pacific band? Do you remember?
The Pacific? Yala. Yala. I thought it was blue. Yala. Yala. The one I seen. With that hat like a plume. Oh, yeah. Yeah.
I remember them in the Pacific band. I was... I don't give all this...
